players.title: Connected Players

aikar.label: Aikar's flags
aikar.desc: Tuned G1GC set for Paper-family servers with 4 GB or more. Best for Paper, Purpur and Spigot.

g1-basic.label: G1GC basic
g1-basic.desc: Light, safe G1 tuning for modded and vanilla servers (Fabric, Forge, NeoForge, Vanilla).

zgc.label: Generational ZGC
zgc.desc: Very low pause times on large heaps. Needs Java 21 or newer.

java23-unsafe.label: Silence Unsafe warning
java23-unsafe.desc: Hides the sun.misc.Unsafe deprecation warning printed by JOML on Java 23+. Do not use on older Java: the server will not start.

errors.JAR_MISSING: Server jar not found. Provision a server engine first.
